capture_note: Source-bound native XCTest simulator captures of original local kit fixtures, including synthetic original meal media. No third-party product screenshot bytes. These are screen-family examples, not isolated specimens of every contained component.
transformations: Complete 1206×2622 simulator viewport downsampled uniformly to 603×1311 using Lanczos, then encoded as lossless WebP. No crop, removal, masking, invented UI, or UI retouching.
review_note: Attachment identities and test names checked against exported XCTest manifest; all 36 full-screen images visually inspected for title/mapping and unexpected overlays. This publication-hygiene review does not confer independent visual acceptance. Native Presentation and Provider Host are launcher states, not active system alert/share-sheet captures.
